title: Normalized ordinary-to-completed scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with an embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $Y$. On the intrinsic derived-complete constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], define sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison to be the unique natural isomorphism from ordinary derived coefficient extension to completed scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] whose component on every good complex $P$ [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex] with constructible localization, followed by the recorded completed-extension localization comparison, is the ordinary exact-derived localization comparison followed by the localization of the quotient-completion chain map. The unshifted Roos coordinates of that map are the finite quotient tensor maps and its shifted coordinate is zero. The uniqueness characterization determines the comparison on all objects and maps, without a finite-field base hypothesis.
